newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Friday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Friday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Friday:
In answer to a question, the Commission confirmed that the Spanish authorities had officially suspended plans to grant 1.9 billion pesetas in aid for the Valadolid Renault plant.
Spokeswoman Heike Gerstbrein said ECU 7 million of the foreseen Spanish aid to the Valadolid Renault plant came from the Objective 1 structural funds programme.
Spokesman Willy Helin said the Commission had to prevent investment aid shopping, which consists of a company moving a plant to an assisted region.
He also said the EU would propose regulations on state aid in the automobile sector.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/193: Renault: statement by Commissioner Padraig Flynn.
- IP/97/194: EU threatens WTO action on U.S. textile rules.
- Speech/97/54: Speech by Commissioner Hans van den Broek on EU support for reform in Romania.
- Speech/97/55: Speech by Commissioner Mario Monti on "Making the single market work - the next steps".
